tools.name: status
tools.description: Bench status + capability catalog + reference rig

tools.name: bus_pins
tools.description: Bus Pirate pin logic levels + pullups

tools.name: gcode_lint
tools.description: Lint G-code: envelope + plunge + temp + feed gates. Args: gcode, profile (cnc|printer)

tools.name: gcode_preview
tools.description: Motion segments for 2D preview. Args: gcode

tools.name: gcode_check
tools.description: Lint G-code for CI (same as lint, machine-readable passes_safety). Args: gcode, profile

tools.name: gcode_estimate
tools.description: Time + travel estimate. Args: gcode, profile

tools.name: printer_live
tools.description: Live Klipper telemetry via Moonraker (Demo when unreachable). Args: url (default MOONRAKER_URL or 127.0.0.1:7125)

tools.name: cnc_probe
tools.description: Probe GRBL with `?` over serial, read-only (Demo when missing). Args: port (default GRBL_PORT)

tools.name: bus_probe
tools.description: Identify Bus Pirate over serial, read-only (Demo when missing). Args: port (default BUS_PIRATE_PORT)

tools.name: scope_idn
tools.description: SCPI *IDN? over TCP for scopes/PSUs/DMMs (Demo when unreachable). Args: addr (default SCOPE_ADDR, ip:port)

tools.name: logic_capture
tools.description: 4-pin logic pattern (Demo until SUMP v3). Args: port, hz, samples

tools.name: scope_usb
tools.description: USB scope via USBTMC *IDN? + best-effort Rigol waveform (Demo when missing; needs WinUSB via Zadig). Args: vid, pid (decimals)

tools.name: logic_usb
tools.description: USB logic analyzer via sigrok-cli (DOWN receipt when absent). Args: driver, hz, samples
